pr.title: Restart agents after transient runtime crashes in consensus wrapper
pr.description:
Add transient crash detection (segfault, OOM, SIGABRT) to the consensus
wrapper so agents can recover from infrastructure failures instead of being
permanently killed. Reuses the existing restart loop with exponential backoff.
Fixes #1512.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: new tests in test_consensus_wrapper.py cover transient crash restart,
  non-transient exit behavior, backoff presence, and exit code classification
- Manual: verify existing tests still pass with `pytest orchestrator/tests/test_consensus_wrapper.py`
